display.label: Plan or commit Customizer source edits
display.summary: Author Customizer SOURCE, not runtime Overrides: plan bounded literal/annotation/group edits with sourceAnalyze version/hash, inspect preview, then commit the single-use planId within 120 seconds. Successful plans return data.continuation: review the diff and invoke its registered tool with its input unchanged (mode and planId only). requiresReview is guidance, never authorization or a Commit input field. Requires Workspace Trust and commit confirmation; never accepts model approval. Writes only the buffer, never saves. On STALE_SOURCE reanalyze and replan; on NEEDS_MANUAL_REVIEW stop unchanged-source retries, use ordinary editor changes only if the user task permits them, otherwise explain manual handling. Check applied AND semanticPass/postValidation; never claim success after failure.

tool.name: scad_ai_ide_customizer_sourceApply
tool.modelDescription: Author Customizer SOURCE, not runtime Overrides: plan bounded literal/annotation/group edits with sourceAnalyze version/hash, inspect preview, then commit the single-use planId within 120 seconds. Successful plans return data.continuation: review the diff and invoke its registered tool with its input unchanged (mode and planId only). requiresReview is guidance, never authorization or a Commit input field. Requires Workspace Trust and commit confirmation; never accepts model approval. Writes only the buffer, never saves. On STALE_SOURCE reanalyze and replan; on NEEDS_MANUAL_REVIEW stop unchanged-source retries, use ordinary editor changes only if the user task permits them, otherwise explain manual handling. Check applied AND semanticPass/postValidation; never claim success after failure.

mode.description: plan requires uri, identity.version, identity.sha256 and edits; commit requires only planId. Copy identity and planId from actual previous results.

identity.description: Nested object copied from sourceAnalyze data.identity: version is a number and sha256 is a string. Do not send version or sha256 as root fields.

edits.description: Array of intent DATA objects. Each has one exact kind and name, with the fields required by that kind. Do not send JSON Schema keywords or a shell command.

planId.description: Opaque ID from a successful sourceApply mode=plan data.planId. Never use sourceAnalyze operation.id.
